orbit the earth: Hundreds of satellites orbit the earth every day, sending us information about weather and traffic.
數百顆人造衛星每天繞地球運行，傳送天氣和交通資訊給我們。
move in different orbits: We were best friends in high school, but now we move in different orbits and rarely meet.
我們高中時是最好的朋友，但現在我們活在不同圈子，很少見面。
put into orbit: The rocket successfully put into orbit a new weather satellite that will help predict typhoons.
火箭成功將一顆新的氣象衛星送入軌道，它將幫助預測颱風。
organize a party: We plan to organize a party for our teacher's birthday and surprise her after class on Friday.
我們打算為老師的生日籌辦派對，在星期五下課後給她一個驚喜。
organize one's thoughts: Before giving a speech, I always take a few minutes to organize my thoughts and write down key points.
演講前，我總會花幾分鐘整理思緒並寫下重點。
organize workers: The young activist helped organize workers at the factory so they could form a union and ask for fair pay.
那位年輕的社運人士協助組織工廠的工人，讓他們能成立工會並爭取合理薪資。
organize files: My computer desktop was a mess, so I deleted old documents and began to organize files into neat folders.
我的電腦桌面一團亂，所以我刪掉舊文件，開始把檔案整理到整齊的資料夾裡。
get organized: If you want to finish all your homework on time, you need to get organized and make a daily plan.
如果你想準時完成所有作業，你需要變得有條理，並擬定每日計畫。
outline the plan: At tomorrow's meeting, the manager will outline the plan step by step so everyone knows their role.
在明天的會議上，經理會一步一步概述計畫，讓每個人都知道自己的角色。
outline the main points: In the first paragraph of your essay, you should outline the main points you will discuss later.
在作文的第一段，你應該列出稍後要討論的要點。
be outlined against the sky: At sunset, the tall mountain was outlined against the sky, which had turned bright orange.
日落時，高山在變成鮮橘色的天空下顯出輪廓。
output data: This program can output data as a colorful chart, so it is easy to compare the sales of each month.
這個程式能把資料輸出成彩色圖表，所以很容易比較每個月的銷售量。
increase output: The factory hired fifty more workers in order to increase output before the busy holiday season.
工廠多雇用了五十名工人，以便在忙碌的節慶季節前提高產量。
output power: This small solar panel can output power of up to one hundred watts on a sunny day.
這塊小型太陽能板在晴天可以輸出高達一百瓦的功率。
overcome difficulties: With help from her friends, she was able to overcome difficulties in her first year abroad.
在朋友的幫助下，她得以克服出國第一年的種種困難。
overcome fear: Climbing the high rock wall in gym class helped me overcome fear and build my confidence.
在體育課爬高高的攀岩牆幫助我戰勝恐懼並建立自信。
be overcome with emotion: When she saw her son walk across the stage at graduation, she was overcome with emotion and cried.
當她看到兒子在畢業典禮上走過舞台時，她激動不已，哭了出來。
overcome obstacles: The movie tells the story of a blind runner who worked hard to overcome obstacles and win a gold medal.
這部電影講述一位努力突破障礙、贏得金牌的盲人跑者的故事。
be overcome by smoke: Two firefighters were overcome by smoke and had to be carried out of the burning building.
兩名消防員被煙嗆倒，必須被抬出燃燒中的大樓。
overlook a mistake: The teacher said she would overlook a mistake this small, but she asked me to be more careful next time.
老師說她會忽略這麼小的錯誤，但要我下次更小心。
overlook the sea: We rented a small house on the hill whose windows overlook the sea, so we could watch the sunrise every day.
我們租了一間山丘上窗戶俯瞰大海的小屋，所以每天都能看日出。
overlook someone for promotion: A good boss should never overlook someone for promotion just because that person is quiet in meetings.
好的老闆絕不該只因某人在會議中很安靜，就在升遷時忽略那個人。
easy to overlook: Small spelling errors are easy to overlook, so always read your essay again before you hand it in.
小的拼字錯誤容易被忽視，所以交作文前一定要再讀一遍。
oversee the project: Mr. Lin was chosen to oversee the project, so he checks the team's progress every week.
林先生被選來監督這個專案，所以他每週都會檢查團隊的進度。
oversee operations: As the new manager, she will oversee operations at all three of the company's factories.
身為新任經理，她將督導公司三間工廠的營運。
oversee staff: She was hired to oversee staff at the hotel and make sure every worker follows the safety rules.
她被雇來管理飯店員工，並確保每位工作人員都遵守安全規定。
overtake a car: It is dangerous to overtake a car on a narrow mountain road where you cannot see what is coming.
在看不到前方來車的狹窄山路上超車是很危險的。
overtake a competitor: By offering lower prices and better service, the small shop managed to overtake a competitor that was much bigger.
藉由提供更低的價格和更好的服務，那家小店成功超越了大得多的對手。
be overtaken by events: Our plan for a beach picnic was overtaken by events when a typhoon suddenly hit the island.
當颱風突然襲擊島嶼時，我們去海邊野餐的計畫就被局勢趕過了。
be overtaken by fear: When the lights suddenly went out in the old house, the children were overtaken by fear and started screaming.
當老房子裡的燈突然熄滅時，孩子們被恐懼淹沒，開始尖叫。
